address: 5F, Dusit Central Park, Rama 4 Road, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: On the fifth floor of Dusit Central Park, this small shop delivers quality Northern Thai noodle soups. Chef-owner Prin Polsuk's Lampang roots shine through in dishes layered with spice and aroma. Standouts include khao soi with coconut-rich curry and a rarer clear-broth option.
